versions.content: Memory handling library Description: AUTOSAR shall offer memory handling functions similar to those found in standard C libraries. Rationale: Standard C libraries are available as part of C compiler environments. Unfortunetally such libraries may interfere with the AUTOSAR environment and cannot be used in all situations. Therefore, AUTOSAR offers own variants of it. E.g. standard C types like size_t or int shall be avoided in AUTOSAR. Use Case: – Dependencies: [SRS_LIBS_00009] Supporting Material: –
